article.title: From anti-caste struggle to women’s liberation: The transformative contribution of Gail Omvedt
article.author: Editor
article.content: Caste reality has still not ended, injustice against women has still not ended, and the problems of farmers and agricultural laborers remain unresolved—in such circumstances, the ideological foundation Dr. Gail laid out, and the path of action she demonstrated, continue to guide scholars and activists of the new generation. The post From anti-caste struggle to women’s liberation: The transformative contribution of Gail Omvedt appeared first on MR Online .
